name: PNG, JPEG, TIFF and BMP import
note: Browser decoding runs locally; TIFF and OME-TIFF are normalized to an analysis canvas without uploading the source.

name: Recursive folder and batch import
note: The browser directory picker imports supported files as one local batch; no directory handle or image leaves the device.

name: ND2, CZI, LIF, OIR and VSI import
note: Proprietary containers need compatible local native readers; this browser release has no such decoder. Export the selected plane as OME-TIFF using a local microscopy tool.

name: SHA-256 duplicate review
note: Raw source bytes are hashed locally and exact duplicates are skipped with a visible import notice.

name: Microscope metadata calibration
note: OME PhysicalSizeX, ImageJ pixelWidth and baseline TIFF resolution metadata are read locally when present; unsupported vendor metadata is disclosed separately.

name: Manual and scale-bar calibration
note: Manual pixels-per-micrometre calibration is editable and persisted per image; the line tool provides a measured reference for scale-bar entry.

name: Calibration presets and persistence
note: Calibration is stored in IndexedDB with the image record and included in deterministic provenance.

name: Cellpose-SAM v2
note: The audited WebGPU adapter is ready, but the exact cpsam_v2 ONNX artifact is not publicly hosted or parity-validated. Build and checksum the pinned artifact before this becomes runnable.

name: Cellpose cyto3
note: Public ONNX files exist, but none has passed this repository's source-checkpoint parity and checksum gate. Package a validated cp-cyto3 artifact; no alternate model is substituted.

name: StarDist versatile fluorescence
note: A browser graph must be exported from the exact 2D_versatile_fluo checkpoint and its postprocessing validated before the WebGPU path is enabled.

name: Batch detection and live progress
note: Persistent local jobs save immutable settings before work. Classical processing supports single images and batches, progress, exact preview reuse, pause/resume/retry and interrupted-launch recovery; learned models still need validated artifacts.

name: Cancellation and orphan cleanup
note: AbortSignal cancellation terminates the dedicated inference worker request and preserves the source plus the prior result.

name: Background subtraction and channel selection
note: Classical analysis reads the selected original source sample or luminance, supports homogeneous TIFF Z projections, and optional 50-pixel local-mean background subtraction. This is a documented browser adaptation of native preprocessing.

name: Touching-cell watershed split
note: The explicit classical detector splits touching foreground regions with a calibrated seeded distance watershed. The browser implementation is not claimed numerically identical to native libraries.

name: Exact detector identity and failure reporting
note: The explicit detector identity, algorithm or manifest version, source digest, runtime, original run calibration and immutable parameters are saved. No learned detector is substituted with the built-in classical engine.

name: Cell morphology and intensity measurements
note: Source-pixel contours produce calibrated diameter, area, perimeter, shape and intensity summaries in deterministic browser kernels.

name: Configurable size bins and histograms
note: Calibrated thresholds are applied consistently to measurements, counts and deterministic exports.

name: Focus and illumination QC
note: Laplacian focus variance and illumination spread are computed from local source pixels without a model or upload.

name: Colony and confluency statistics
note: Binary masks yield occupied area, connected colonies and calibrated confluence summaries entirely in the browser.

name: Multi-channel intensity assays
note: Marker positivity, nuclear-to-cytoplasm ratio, colocalization, viability, transfection and cell-cycle summaries run on local typed arrays.

name: Scratch, spheroid and colony-area assays
note: Mask-based confluence, wound closure, spheroid area and colony metrics run deterministically in a Web Worker-compatible engine.

name: Puncta and foci analysis
note: Local peak detection finds channel-selectable puncta and assigns them to source-pixel cell polygons.

name: Spatial statistics
note: Nearest-neighbour, local density and Clark–Evans statistics use calibrated centroid geometry.

name: Sequence tracking and migration
note: Ordered frame detections are linked locally with explicit frame interval, displacement limit and calibration-aware migration metrics.

name: Neurite outgrowth
note: A user-supplied neurite mask is skeletonized locally and attributed to detected soma centroids with calibrated length summaries.

name: Line profile tool
note: Two source-pixel endpoints generate bounded bilinear RGB and luma samples plus calibrated distance.

name: Mask fills, contours, boxes and markers
note: The image canvas renders source-coordinate contours and selection markers with responsive transforms.

name: Add, remove, resize, merge and split
note: Source-coordinate add, remove, resize, merge and split tools update measured cells and correction history; bounded undo and redo restore cells, validation marks and ROIs.

name: Ground truth and live precision/recall/F1
note: Ground-truth markers are drawn and persisted in source pixels; precision, recall and F1 update live, with clear and undo controls.

name: Include and exclude ROIs
note: Include and exclude rectangles are drawn, cleared, undone and persisted; their centroid filter is applied consistently to summaries, assays, comparison and exports.

name: Notes and per-image confidence
note: Free-form image notes and high, medium or low review confidence are edited in the inspector, persisted locally and included in provenance export.

name: Image library and duplicate groups
note: Images, analyses and conditions persist locally in IndexedDB/OPFS; source hashes drive exact duplicate handling.

name: Batch summaries and conditions
note: Locally persisted conditions group image results for aggregate counts, diameters and distributions.

name: Low-confidence review queue
note: Low-confidence and all-unreviewed queues offer card/grid review in fixed pages of 100. Accepting an object records its review decision separately from model confidence, including in low-confidence fields.

name: Condition comparison and Mann–Whitney U
note: Local condition groups render aggregate counts and size comparisons with deterministic summary export.

name: Analysis protocol save/apply
note: Versioned protocol JSON is validated and applied atomically; invalid model IDs or parameters return actionable errors.

name: Fine-tuning and checkpoint lineage
note: Browser-only Cellpose training requires a browser-compatible optimizer, checkpoint format and validated training/evaluation path that are absent. Use the native application to train and evaluate reviewed masks.

name: Cells and batch CSV
note: Deterministic CSV and JSON are generated locally with stable columns and no upload.

name: ImageJ ROI ZIP
note: Source-pixel contours are encoded into an ImageJ-compatible RoiSet ZIP entirely in the browser.

name: Cellpose _seg.npy round-trip
note: Browser export provides a safe bare uint32 NumPy label mask today. Full Cellpose GUI _seg.npy dictionary round-trip requires a safe object-array/pickle codec and importer that is not yet implemented.

name: Reproducibility provenance
note: Image digest, exact model manifest, calibration, thresholds, corrections, runtime and timestamps are exported together.

name: PDF lab report
note: A compact standards-valid PDF report is composed and downloaded locally without external fonts or services.

name: Annotated PNG and mirrored folder export
note: The source image and corrected contours are composited at source resolution in a local canvas and downloaded as PNG.

name: GeoJSON contours
note: RFC 7946 polygons retain source-pixel geometry and measured-versus-approximated contour provenance.

name: Local-only storage and reset
note: Images, results and model artifacts remain in browser storage; reset removes the local project without a server call.

name: Keyboard and accessible interaction
note: Semantic controls, visible focus, ARIA labels, keyboard shortcuts, reduced motion, light and dark themes are first-class.

name: Support and parity disclosure
note: This source-derived 47-item inventory is rendered in-product so browser gaps cannot disappear silently.

name: Classical threshold and watershed
note: Built-in Otsu, triangle, adaptive and manual thresholds run in a local CPU worker with no weights. Minimum size, dark foreground, source sample and a seeded watershed are explicit controls.

name: Source channels and Z projection
note: Classical analysis uses original TIFF samples and first/max/mean/sum homogeneous Z planes, up to 64 planes and 4 million pixels. Separate OME time/channel planes need local conversion before projection.

name: Representative-image preview and reuse
note: Inspect an imported field, preview its entire selected source plane and keep the preview separate from saved results. Only identical source bytes, calibration, detector identity and settings reuse it.

name: Persistent processing and recovery
note: Each source and its calibration are recorded before processing. Pause finishes the active image; cancellation retains prior results. Reload pauses interrupted jobs; resume and retry preserve completed work.

name: Linked image, table and scatter selection
note: Stable cell IDs connect canvas, a 50-row measurement table and a scatter plot capped at 600 points. Diameter filtering evaluates every included cell, and selection can reveal rows on later pages.

name: Reversible mask variants
note: Saved alternatives share current canvas pan/zoom and report centroid-matched added, removed, changed and unchanged objects. Applying an alternative preserves the current mask and run metadata while recalibrating measurements.

name: Screen-aware keyboard commands
note: Workspace commands are enabled only for the relevant screen, image and running state. Text editing, composing input, dialog Escape and modified browser keys keep their expected behavior.

name: OME-Zarr / OME-NGFF arrays and plates
note: Local multiscale arrays, plates, wells and fields are absent from the browser. Export a supported image plane from a local microscopy viewer.

name: Time, Z and channel navigation with multiscale resolution
note: Full multidimensional navigation and automatic resolution selection are absent. Browser analysis supports a bounded first-plane or homogeneous Z projection only.

name: Complete native source-plane preview
note: The full native source-plane preview and format coverage are absent. Browser classical analysis displays its selected plane; other browser assays may use the normalized import raster.

name: Image, label, point, shape, surface and track layers
note: A complete layer workspace with visibility, opacity and layer transforms is absent. Browser overlays cover object masks, reference points and rectangular regions.

name: Layer registration and bounded grid mosaics
note: Native translation registration, stitching and overlap-aware mosaics are absent. Prepare aligned or stitched images in a local microscopy tool before browser import.

name: Lineage construction and relationship editing
note: Native lineage building and split, merge and gap-closing relationships are absent. Browser tracking assays do not provide the native lineage workspace.

name: Pixel label painting and training-mask export
note: Pixel-class label painting with undo and 16-bit training-mask export are absent. Browser geometric corrections and label PNG exports are narrower workflows.

name: Saved microscopy workspaces and recorded workflow replay
note: The native layer project format and repeatable recorded-workflow replay are absent. Browser protocols preserve analysis settings, not a full microscopy workspace.

name: Keyframed image-sequence GIF export
note: Keyframed workspace animations and image-sequence GIF export are absent. Browser exports cover individual result images and measurement reports.

name: Prompt-guided mask refinement
note: Native prompt-guided refinement is absent from this browser version. Use the available geometric correction tools or a supported native method.

name: Sequence propagation and drift correction
note: Native correction propagation across sequences and drift correction are absent. The browser tracking assay does not replace these editing workflows.

name: Full native preprocessing and parameter optimization
note: The full native preprocessing and optimization workflow is absent. Browser classical detection offers local-mean subtraction and threshold controls only.

name: Reviewed training library, immutable checkpoints and rollback
note: Reviewed-library training datasets, model training, checkpoint validation and rollback are absent. Browser review acceptance does not train a model.

name: Additional native models, custom models and ensembles
note: Native SAM, Omnipose, custom model and ensemble workflows are absent. The browser includes classical detection; its three listed learned models still require tested browser artifacts.

name: Curated microscopy workspace extensions
note: The native curated extension catalogue is absent from the browser. No browser extension loader or third-party code execution is provided.
